purpose: Track the language-model families SEIS may evaluate for local/private use, retrieval, adapter experiments, or future supervised training without bulk-downloading models, bypassing licenses, exposing secrets, or claiming unsupported SEIS-owned foundation models.
truthBoundary: Model intake registry only. It installs no models, downloads no weights, trains no foundation model, runs no inference, calls no providers, reads no credentials, and proves no AGI capability.

sourceResearch.usedFor: Public local-runtime model-family discovery for Llama, DeepSeek, Gemma, Qwen, Mistral, embedding, and coding model families.

Training and inference framework boundary: Transformers supports model definitions, training, distributed training, quantization, and many ecosystem runtimes, but model license and checkpoint provenance remain separate gates.
Frontier-scale planning baseline: 405B-class models require explicit compute, safety, evaluation, and license review; they are not ordinary local installs.

installPolicy.reason: Installing every language model is not safe or useful without license, storage, hardware, security, and evaluation gates.

requiredBeforeAnyModelInstall: human approval for the specific model id and quantization
disk, RAM, GPU/CPU, and thermal budget estimate
checkpoint source, checksum, and provenance record
requiredBeforeAnyTraining: completed dataset card with source inventory and license map
PII, secrets, credentials, and private-data scan
training objective and expected artifact type
eval suite and held-out benchmark definition

notes: 405B-class use is frontier-scale and requires separate budget, safety, and license review.
Use only sanitized, license-reviewed checkpoints; Qwen assistant output remains candidate evidence until Codex validates it.
Good candidate for local/offline experiments only after license, hardware, and fallback gates.
Do not mix Apache, community, modified, or proprietary licenses without explicit review.
MoE total parameter count and active parameter count must be tracked separately.
Do not confuse OpenAI API models, Codex/ChatGPT assistance, and any separate open-weight model artifact.
Preferred first real model lane for SEIS knowledge retrieval because it can improve recall without claiming foundation-model ownership.
Coding models may propose patches, but SEIS must validate with tests and security checks before accepting output.

hardwareInstallLanes.allowedToday: metadata and deterministic seed-model lab only
hardwareInstallLanes.candidateModelClass: small or quantized local model after approval

blockedClasses: all runtime until budget, safety, eval, observability, and approval exist

trainingLanes.meaning: Deterministic SEIS-owned seed models for permission policy, memory ranking, eval criticism, and agent routing.
Index SEIS docs and evidence with reviewed embeddings or local retrieval before any LLM fine-tune.
Small adapter experiment only after model license, dataset card, model card, and benchmark plan are accepted.
Full fine-tune requires explicit approval, compute budget, checkpoint governance, and safety evaluation.
True SEIS-owned foundation model pretraining requires dataset provenance, training logs, checkpoints, model cards, and independent benchmarks.

knowledgeStrategy.goal: Tam bilgili SEIS means evidence-backed retrieval and evaluated reasoning, not pretending a single model memorized everything.
preferredOrder: adapter or fine-tune only after dataset and model cards
frontier model research only after evidence chain
knowledgeStrategy.forbiddenShortcut: Do not scrape or download everything to make a model appear knowledgeable.

forbiddenClaims: SEIS can use all model checkpoints without license review.
SEIS can download datasets without provenance review.
SEIS can send private repository data to external providers by default.
nextSafeActions: Keep the registry as metadata-only until a single target model is approved.
Prioritize retrieval/embedding intake before any fine-tune.
Run the workforce seed-model training validator after registry changes.
Create separate model cards and dataset cards for any future local model experiment.
